svg.title: Components, Deskmates v2
svg.text: Deskmates v2 · the shared parts every key screen is built from. Light theme; dark where the colours change.
44 px tall, radius 13. Primary has a 3 px lip that drops on press.
Small, 40 px (laptop only); 44 px on touch
Radius 14, 46–48 px. Focus: accent border plus a 3 px soft ring.
Write your reply first, then post it.
Pills, 44 px on touch. The one dark pill is Filters, with a yellow count.
In-page tabs: a 3 px underline in the section colour, counts in a pill.
Index cards: radius 18, a 1.5 px line, a soft shadow. Documents carry a coloured top band.
Cramér–Rao bound: why n·I(θ) and not I(θ)?
One row per sitting, a cell per zone and the report. The hovered row sits on inset.
Ink on light, raised on dark. The desk-mate switches to happy and hops 6 px.
ConfirmDialog: radius 22, a title that asks, a body that says what happens, the safe action first.
Its 3 replies go too. This can’t be
She stays off every page until you
bring her back from your account.
84 px plus the home indicator. Active: navy line, full section colour, pill, bold label.
Default, hover, active, focus ring, and a count.
The timer pill: idle, running, 10 minutes left (warning), 2 minutes left (exam colour).
